## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Strained Back | You overcommit and wrench your back or shoulders. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength. | Moderate |  |
| 14-16 | Slipped Grip | Your hands slide off what you were lifting, pulling, or holding. The effort fails and control is lost. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Finger Crush | Weight shifts suddenly and crushes or pinches your hand. Suffer 1 point of damage to Agility or Strength, GM's choice. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Unbalanced Heave | You move the object, but badly. It topples, rolls, or crashes where you did not intend. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Torn Muscle | The effort tears something in your arm, chest, or leg. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength and stop the attempt. | High |  |
| 34-36 | Broken Handle | Rope, lever, strap, haft, or handle gives out under the load. The tool or setup is ruined. | Moderate |  |
| 41-43 | Dropped Load | What you are lifting or carrying falls hard, damaging the cargo, the ground, or someone nearby. | High |  |
| 44-46 | Pinned Under Weight | The load shifts onto you instead of away from you. You are trapped until someone helps free you. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Violent Recoil | The thing you were holding shut, bracing, or restraining bursts loose with force. You are thrown or struck. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Structural Failure | Door, beam, wagon part, or other stressed object breaks suddenly under pressure. The whole situation gets worse immediately. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Crushing Injury | The failed feat of strength inflicts a serious blow. Suffer an attack with five Base Dice. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Catastrophic Collapse | Your failed exertion brings down, releases, or unleashes something large and dangerous on everyone nearby. | Catastrophic |  |
